Lily wanted to build a tower, but her sister Tom said to Lily, "No, we want to build a tower with their blocks. But we can't build it. Maybe there will make it another."
Lily said, "No, I want to build something. I want to create big tower."
Tom was stubborn and did not want to buildings. He thought they were wrong. He said, "I am sorry, Lily. Maybe we can build a tower together. Let's build our tower."
Lily started to build her tower. She was happy. She said, "Thank you, Tom. You are very good friends."
Tom did not wait to build her tower. But then he saw that Lily was sad. He said, "You are very smart and selfish. You are my best brother."
